hypothesis: The linked ADC compare application, the threshold driver and the host decoder handle accumulated events, window changes and refusals in software.
conclusion: Software evidence only; physical comparison, boundary behavior and interrupt delivery are unqualified.
narrative: Host-only results from checks that have since been removed (adc-compare-native, adc-threshold, adc-application-native). The linked-image check executed the linked application, the actual GPADC core, the native register policy and the USB serializer with modeled MMIO effects, clock/rail/PMIC service results, time, RTOS calls, GIC outcomes and USB transport. Seven cases covered accumulated events including threshold-only service, zero events, changed windows, unselected pending status, failed stop, cancellation and deadline expiry. The original version-1 linked cases passed on the same image. Both versions passed actual producer, session admission, sealed bundle and host capture checks; the version-3 host also refused rehashed reports carrying unselected event bits. The threshold check linked the actual driver and clock registry with modeled MMIO; nine cases covered programmed windows, latched events with and without fresh data, configured disable, window refusals, unselected-channel status, changed windows or enables, inherited compare enables, a failed window write and a non-owner query. Mutating the window verification, the high-status acknowledgement, the disable of high interrupts or the startup programming made it fail. The passive GPADC, clock-reference, configured-disable and LRADC host checks and the linked ADC application model passed on a rebuilt image. Counted costs on the linked image with selected mask 5: startup controller accesses rose from 31 reads and 6 writes to 43 reads and 10 writes; a four-channel service without threshold events rose from 18 reads and 1 write to 20 reads and 1 write; each nonzero low/high status adds one acknowledgement; consuming the latch adds no MMIO; completion adds 22 reads and 5 writes for configured disable; the native object grew by 24 bytes, the application object by 48 bytes including alignment, linked text by 2,792 bytes, linked BSS unchanged. Evidence: ~/.cache/sunstoneos/evidence/adc-compare-20261028/ (costs.json). No board timing was measured.
